mapper.select: select from sys_role where name = #{name} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_role( id , tenant_id, name , data_scope , status , menu_ids , delete_flag , created_by , created_dt , updated_by , updated_dt ) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{dataScope}, #{status}, #{menuIds}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdDt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedDt})
mapper.select: select IFNULL(max(data_scope),1) from sys_role where delete_flag = 1 and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id in (select role_id from sys_role_user where user_id = #{userId})
